items.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998
items.q: I like Vanessa, Vanessa Rubin. Are you familiar with her?

ctx.x: That we won’t talk about. Those kind of places. Are there people out, new jazz singers, that you enjoy these days? Do you get a chance to listen much?
I don’t hear too much but I like Vanessa, Vanessa Rubin. Are you familiar with her?
